item.title: Openvscode-server Deprecation Notice
item.description: Due to the upstream project no longer updating their app, we have decided to deprecate our Openvscode-server image. We recommend switching to the Code-server or the VSCodium-web image.
item.content: Due to the upstream project no longer updating their app, we have decided to deprecate our Openvscode-server image. We recommend switching to the Code-server or the VSCodium-web image.

item.title: New Container: OpenVSCode Server
item.description:
We have released a new container for OpenVSCode Server!

OpenVSCode Server provides a version of VS Code that runs a server on a remote machine and allows access through a modern web browser.
